decisions.reason: The Android effect is already fully represented by the existing message-71 MODIFY setting google_play_language_count to 77; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Selecting the complete store language sets does not change the existing requirement that layouts render correctly for RTL locales.
The selected App Store language coverage does not alter the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
Choosing all approximately 40 App Store languages does not modify the existing iOS size-optimization goal or localized tutorial asset strategy.
Language coverage is independent of the requirement to remove unused Android permissions such as READ_PHONE_STATE.
The App Store language-set decision does not change iOS framework modernization, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The number of App Store languages does not change the need for valid iOS signing certificates and configuration.
Selecting all 77 Google Play languages is already handled by the Android localization requirement and does not itself modify the separate Android size-optimization state.
The language-list selection does not alter Android OS/framework modernization, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
